name: [🎃] Dig & Clean 🧼
desc:
Welcome to Dig & Clean!

How to Play:
⛏️ Dig up dirty junk and buried treasure!
💦 Spray it clean and find out what it is!
💎 Hunt for the rarest items in the game!
🏛️ Show off your best finds in your own museum!
🚀 Buy better shovels and spray bottles!

📱 Play on Mobile, Tablet, PC and Console!

Grab a shovel. Let's see what you get!
